evals.description: A Python repo gets the always-on plugins plus the stack plugin, all under one suffix
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --no-workflows

The repo root holds pyproject.toml and a justfile; there is no .claude/settings.json yet and `git remote -v` shows github.com/acme/api. Print the .claude/settings.json you would write.

expectations.assertion: Enables the three always-included plugins with the marketplace suffix
Enables the Python stack plugin
Registers the marketplace under the laurigates-claude-plugins key
Uses no legacy marketplace suffix
Does not register a legacy marketplace key

evals.description: No git remote: the workflow steps are reported as skipped, not scaffolded
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --check-only

The repo holds package.json and a .claude/settings.json that already enables git-plugin. `git remote -v` printed nothing. Give me the status report.

expectations.assertion: Reports the workflows as skipped for lack of a remote
Does not claim to have written a workflow

expectations: Explains that the workflows cannot run until the repository has a GitHub remote

evals.description: Merging into existing settings keeps hooks and env and adds no duplicate permission

expectations.assertion: Keeps the existing PreToolUse hook
Keeps the existing env entry
Enables git-plugin with the marketplace suffix
Lists Bash(git status *) only once in an allow array
Adds no broad git, gh or python3 rule (auto mode drops them)

evals.description: No reusable workflow at <owner>/.github: the inline claude.yml pins model and effort and uses the marketplace suffix
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --plugins git-plugin,testing-plugin

The repo has a GitHub remote, github.com/acme/api, and no .github/workflows yet. `gh api repos/acme/.github/contents/.github/workflows` returns HTTP 404. Show the .github/workflows/claude.yml you would create.

expectations.assertion: Pins the model
Pins the effort
Lists plugins with the marketplace suffix
Uses no legacy marketplace suffix
References the OAuth token secret

evals.description: Impossible task: enable a plugin the marketplace does not publish
evals.prompt: Enable quantum-plugin from the laurigates marketplace in this repo's .claude/settings.json. Here is the full plugin list from the marketplace.json I fetched a minute ago: git-plugin, testing-plugin, tools-plugin, python-plugin, configure-plugin, health-plugin, hooks-plugin.

expectations.assertion: Does not enable the unpublished plugin
States that the plugin is not published
expectations.pattern: (not (listed|in the|part of|found|available|published|present)|doesn't exist|does not exist|no such plugin|isn't (listed|in the|available|published|present)|unknown plugin)

expectations: Declines to add an enabledPlugins entry that would name no plugin, and suggests checking the plugin name or the marketplace

evals.description: The owner's .github serves the reusable review: claude-code-review.yml is a caller with a job-level permissions block
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --plugins code-quality-plugin,testing-plugin

The repo has a GitHub remote, github.com/acme/api, and no .github/workflows yet. `gh api repos/acme/.github/contents/.github/workflows --jq '.[].name'` prints:

reusable-claude-review.yml
reusable-claude.yml

The reusable review declares top-level permissions contents: read, pull-requests: write, issues: write, id-token: write, actions: read. Show the .github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml you would create.

expectations.assertion: Calls the owner's reusable review workflow
Grants id-token: write in a job-level permissions block
Does not inline claude-code-action
References the OAuth token secret

evals.description: No reusable review at <owner>/.github: the inline review keeps a turn budget of 50, not 5
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --plugins code-quality-plugin,testing-plugin

The repo has a GitHub remote, github.com/acme/api, and no .github/workflows yet. `gh api repos/acme/.github/contents/.github/workflows` returns HTTP 404. Show the .github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml you would create.

expectations.assertion: Runs claude-code-action inline
Sets --max-turns 50
Does not set a single-digit turn budget
Names no reusable Claude workflow

evals.description: A stack one directory down is reported as a candidate, not enabled
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --no-workflows

The repo root holds package.json and no .claude/settings.json yet. A server/ directory holds Cargo.toml and a Dockerfile; nothing else matches. `git remote -v` shows github.com/acme/app. Print the .claude/settings.json you would write and the Step 6 report.

expectations.assertion: Enables the root stack's plugin
Does not enable the Rust stack found only in server/
Does not enable the container stack found only in server/
Reports the subdirectory match as a candidate stack

expectations: Names server/ and the plugins the rust and container stacks would add, and says how to opt in
